note: Canonical list of organisations credited in data/database/maps.json. The provider field was free text, so the same body appeared under several spellings and nothing caught a new one. check:provider-names enforces this list. Aliases are spellings that have been merged away and must not reappear. pendingReview marks an unresolved question about how a body should be credited, not a defect in the data.
